maddeler.e:
استعلما (form X)
# اِسْتَعْلَمَا (istaʕlamā) /is.taʕ.la.maː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
# اُسْتُعْلِمَا (ustuʕlimā) /us.tuʕ.li.maː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
# اِسْتَعْلِمَا (istaʕlimā) /is.taʕ.li.maː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
